LESSON: MILAD UN-NABI

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.1: Milad un-Nabi

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Milad un-Nabi. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: When was the Prophet 7. 0 ISLAMIC learner should be able to: praise of the Prophet (S.A.W). (S.A.W) born?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Appreciate Aqiqah as an Islamic ritual for all children

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Appreciate Aqiqah as an Islamic ritual for all children
   In simple words: practise until you can appreciate Aqiqah as an Islamic ritual for all children. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Milad un-Nabi using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Milad un-Nabi in the examples.
2. Explain Milad un-Nabi to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Milad un-Nabi.
4. Show that you can: Appreciate Aqiqah as an Islamic ritual for all children

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Milad un-Nabi using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Milad un-Nabi important for a Grade 2 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
